name: hindsight
one_liner: Gives AI chatbots and assistants a real memory that improves over time, instead of forgetting everything the moment a conversation ends.
buyer: A SaaS founder building an AI customer-support or personal-assistant product who needs it to remember each user's history and preferences across sessions without building memory infrastructure from scratch.
business_use_cases: A customer-support chatbot vendor plugs it in so returning customers never have to re-explain their account issue from scratch.
A personal-AI-assistant startup uses it to let the assistant recall a user's stated preferences ('I'm vegetarian', 'I hate early meetings') months later without re-asking.
An enterprise knowledge-work tool gives every employee's AI copilot persistent memory of that employee's projects, so answers stay contextual over time.

money_ideas.idea: Charge for the hosted Hindsight Cloud tier, billed by memory volume and retrieval calls.
Sell enterprise deployment and integration support to companies wiring it into existing agent products.

steal_this: This weekend, bolt Hindsight onto an existing customer-support bot via its LLM wrapper (2 lines of code per their docs) and ship 'remembers you' as a headline feature.
